args.code:
import math
pts=[]
pose=[0.0,0.0,0.0]
last_t=None
mode='rev'
fwd_dist=0.0
dir_w=None
seq=[150,64,-64,-150,-64,64]
seq_i=0
seq_t=0.0
last_print=-10

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def clip(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global last_t,mode,fwd_dist,dir_w,seq_i,seq_t,last_print
    t=obs['t']
    m=obs['motion']; v=m['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    if last_t is not None:
        h=t-last_t
        x,y,yw=pose
        yw2=yw+v*math.tan(math.radians(st))/2.5*h
        x+=v*math.cos((yw+yw2)/2)*h; y+=v*math.sin((yw+yw2)/2)*h
        pose[0]=x; pose[1]=y; pose[2]=yw2
        if mode=='fwd': fwd_dist+=abs(v)*h
    last_t=t
    x,y,yw=pose; c=math.cos(yw); s=math.sin(yw)
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    for name,vw in views.items():
        if not vw: continue
        ox,oy=vw['origin']
        for w in vw.get('walls',[]):
            b,d=w[0],w[1]
            px=ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)); py=oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))
            pts.append((x+c*px-s*py,y+s*px+c*py,t))
    keep=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<4.0]
    pts[:]=keep[-1500:]
    loc=[]
    for wx,wy,_ in pts:
        dx=wx-x; dy=wy-y
        loc.append((c*dx+s*dy,-s*dx+c*dy))
    rig=obs['rig']
    rx,ry=rig['trailer_rear']
    th=rig['trailer_heading_deg']
    psi_b=th+180.0
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']
    tdir=None
    tg=obs.get('target') or {}
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
        ex,ey=rig['eye']
        tb=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); td=tg['dist_m']
        tx=ex+td*math.cos(tb); ty=ey+td*math.sin(tb)
        tdir=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-ry,tx-rx))
    best=None; bestsc=-1e9; bestfree=10.0
    prev_v=None
    if dir_w is not None: prev_v=math.degrees(dir_w-yw)
    for a in range(-70,71,5):
        ang=psi_b+a
        ux=math.cos(math.radians(ang)); uy=math.sin(math.radians(ang))
        free=10.0
        for px,py in loc:
            dx=px-rx; dy=py-ry
            al=dx*ux+dy*uy
            if al<=0 or al>=free: continue
            lat=abs(dx*uy-dy*ux)
            if lat<1.35: free=al
        sc=free-0.02*abs(a)
        if tdir is not None: sc-=0.04*abs(wrap(ang-tdir))
        if prev_v is not None: sc-=0.01*abs(wrap(ang-prev_v))
        if sc>bestsc: bestsc=sc; best=ang; bestfree=free
    bw=math.radians(best)+yw
    if dir_w is None: dir_w=bw
    else:
        d=math.atan2(math.sin(bw-dir_w),math.cos(bw-dir_w))
        dir_w+=0.3*d
    dv=math.degrees(dir_w-yw)
    e=wrap(dv-psi_b)
    status=obs.get('status')
    if mode=='rev':
        if status=='JACKKNIFED' or abs(phi)>45 or bestfree<0.5:
            mode='fwd'; fwd_dist=0.0
    if mode=='fwd':
        if (fwd_dist>1.0 and abs(phi)<10) or fwd_dist>3.0:
            mode='rev'
    if mode=='rev':
        phi_des=clip(0.8*e,-30,30)
        pr=math.radians(phi)
        ff=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(pr)/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(pr))))
        steer=clip(ff+2.5*(phi-phi_des),-45,45)
        spd=-0.5
        if bestfree<1.5: spd=-0.3
        rem=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('remaining')
        if rem is not None and rem<3: spd=-0.3
    else:
        steer=clip(-0.6*phi,-25,25)
        spd=0.8
    if t-seq_t>0.7:
        seq_i=(seq_i+1)%len(seq); seq_t=t
    look=seq[seq_i]
    if t-last_print>5:
        last_print=t
        print('t%.1f %s phi%.1f e%.1f free%.1f steer%.1f n%d'%(t,mode,phi,e,bestfree,steer,len(pts)))
    return (steer,spd,look)

import math
pts=[]
pose=[0.0,0.0,0.0]
last_t=None
mode='fwd'
fwd_dist=0.0
fwd_len=1.3
fwd_steer=25.0
dir_w=None
seq=[150,64,-64,-150,-64,64]
seq_i=0
seq_t=0.0
last_print=-10
last_touch=None
flip_t=-100
still_t=None

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def clip(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global last_t,mode,fwd_dist,fwd_len,fwd_steer,dir_w,seq_i,seq_t,last_print,last_touch,flip_t,still_t
    t=obs['t']
    m=obs['motion']; v=m['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    if last_t is not None:
        h=t-last_t
        x,y,yw=pose
        yw2=yw+v*math.tan(math.radians(st))/2.5*h
        x+=v*math.cos((yw+yw2)/2)*h; y+=v*math.sin((yw+yw2)/2)*h
        pose[0]=x; pose[1]=y; pose[2]=yw2
        if mode=='fwd': fwd_dist+=abs(v)*h
    last_t=t
    x,y,yw=pose; c=math.cos(yw); s=math.sin(yw)
    rig=obs['rig']
    vf=rig.get('vehicle_front',3.2)
    if isinstance(vf,(list,tuple)): vf=vf[0]
    try: vf=float(vf)
    except Exception: vf=3.2
    hw=rig.get('vehicle_half_width',1.15) or 1.15
    near_r=False; near_l=False; dang_r=False; dang_l=False; crit_r=False; crit_l=False
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    for name,vw in views.items():
        if not vw: continue
        ox,oy=vw['origin']
        for w in vw.get('walls',[]):
            b,d=w[0],w[1]
            px=ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)); py=oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))
            if -0.3<px<vf+0.4:
                if -(hw+0.3)<py<0: near_r=True
                if 0<py<hw+0.3: near_l=True
            if 1.2<px<vf+0.3:
                if -(hw+0.2)<py<0: dang_r=True
                if 0<py<hw+0.2: dang_l=True
                if -(hw+0.1)<py<0: crit_r=True
                if 0<py<hw+0.1: crit_l=True
            if name=='periphery': continue
            pts.append((x+c*px-s*py,y+s*px+c*py,t))
    keep=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<10.0]
    pts[:]=keep[-3000:]
    loc=[]; fresh=[]
    for wx,wy,tt in pts:
        dx=wx-x; dy=wy-y
        lp=(c*dx+s*dy,-s*dx+c*dy)
        loc.append(lp)
        if t-tt<1.5: fresh.append(lp)
    rx,ry=rig['trailer_rear']
    hx,hy=rig['hitch']
    th=rig['trailer_heading_deg']
    thw=rig.get('trailer_half_width',1.2) or 1.2
    psi_b=th+180.0
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']
    fx=math.cos(math.radians(th)); fy=math.sin(math.radians(th))
    rxu=fy; ryu=-fx
    cfr=(hx-0.4*fx+thw*rxu, hy-0.4*fy+thw*ryu)
    cfl=(hx-0.4*fx-thw*rxu, hy-0.4*fy-thw*ryu)
    dfr=9.0; dfl=9.0
    for px,py in fresh:
        dfr=min(dfr,math.hypot(px-cfr[0],py-cfr[1]))
        dfl=min(dfl,math.hypot(px-cfl[0],py-cfl[1]))
    touches=obs['counters']['touches']
    if last_touch is None: last_touch=touches
    prog=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('covered') or 0.0
    rem=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('remaining')
    tdir=None
    tg=obs.get('target') or {}
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
        ex,ey=rig['eye']
        tb=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); td=tg['dist_m']
        tx=ex+td*math.cos(tb); ty=ey+td*math.sin(tb)
        tdir=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-ry,tx-rx))
    best=None; bestsc=-1e9; bestfree=8.0
    prev_v=None
    if dir_w is not None: prev_v=math.degrees(dir_w-yw)
    for a in range(-60,61,5):
        ang=psi_b+a
        ux=math.cos(math.radians(ang)); uy=math.sin(math.radians(ang))
        free=8.0
        for px,py in loc:
            dx=px-rx; dy=py-ry
            al=dx*ux+dy*uy
            if al<=-0.5 or al>=free: continue
            lat=abs(dx*uy-dy*ux)
            if lat<1.5: free=max(al,0.0)
        sc=free-0.02*abs(a)
        if prog<16 and tdir is None: sc-=0.03*a
        if tdir is not None: sc-=0.05*abs(wrap(ang-tdir))
        if prev_v is not None: sc-=0.01*abs(wrap(ang-prev_v))
        if sc>bestsc: bestsc=sc; best=ang; bestfree=free
    bw=math.radians(best)+yw
    if dir_w is None: dir_w=bw
    else:
        d=math.atan2(math.sin(bw-dir_w),math.cos(bw-dir_w))
        dir_w+=0.3*d
    dv=math.degrees(dir_w-yw)
    e=wrap(dv-psi_b)
    status=obs.get('status')
    hold=m.get('hold_s') or 0
    def go_fwd(steer_dir,ln):

        mode='fwd'; fwd_dist=0.0; fwd_len=ln; fwd_steer=steer_dir; flip_t=t; still_t=None
    if touches>last_touch:
        last_touch=touches

            if crit_r or dang_r: go_fwd(25.0,1.3)
            elif crit_l or dang_l: go_fwd(-25.0,1.3)
            else: go_fwd(None,1.5)
        else:
            mode='rev'; flip_t=t
    if abs(v)<0.03 and hold<=0:
        if still_t is None: still_t=t
        elif t-still_t>6 and t-flip_t>6:
            if mode=='rev': go_fwd(None,1.5)
            else: mode='rev'; flip_t=t; still_t=None
    else: still_t=None
    if mode=='rev':
        if status=='JACKKNIFED' or abs(phi)>50 or bestfree<0.4:
            go_fwd(None,2.0)
        elif crit_r and not crit_l and v<-0.05:
            go_fwd(25.0,1.2)
        elif crit_l and not crit_r and v<-0.05:
            go_fwd(-25.0,1.2)
    if mode=='fwd':
        if fwd_dist>fwd_len and (fwd_steer is not None or abs(phi)<12 or fwd_dist>fwd_len+1.0):
            mode='rev'; flip_t=t
    if mode=='rev':
        phi_des=clip(-0.8*e,-26,26)
        if dfr<0.4: phi_des=min(phi_des,phi-10)
        if dfl<0.4: phi_des=max(phi_des,phi+10)
        pr=math.radians(phi)
        ff=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(pr)/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(pr))))
        steer=clip(ff+2.5*(phi-phi_des),-45,45)
        if dang_r and not dang_l and dfr>=0.4 and phi<30: steer=min(steer,0)
        if dang_l and not dang_r and dfl>=0.4 and phi>-30: steer=max(steer,0)
        spd=-0.35
        if bestfree<1.5 or near_r or near_l or dfr<0.5 or dfl<0.5: spd=-0.25
        if rem is not None and rem<3: spd=-0.25
    else:
        if fwd_steer is not None: steer=fwd_steer
        else:
            steer=clip(-0.8*phi,-30,30)
            if near_r: steer=max(steer,10)
            if near_l: steer=min(steer,-10)
        spd=0.6
    if t-seq_t>0.7:
        seq_i=(seq_i+1)%len(seq); seq_t=t
    look=seq[seq_i]
    if t-last_print>4:
        last_print=t
        print('t%.1f %s phi%.1f e%.1f free%.1f st%.1f prog%.1f dfr%.2f dfl%.2f dr%d cr%d %s'%(t,mode,phi,e,bestfree,steer,prog,dfr,dfl,dang_r,crit_r,status))
    return (steer,spd,look)

import math
pts=[]
pose=[0.0,0.0,0.0]
last_t=None
mode='fwd'
plan=[[2.0,0.0],[2.3,26.0],[2.3,-26.0]]
seg_d=0.0
dir_w=None
seq_i=0
seq_t=0.0
last_print=-10
last_touch=None
flip_t=-100
still_t=None

def wrap(a):
    while a>180: a-=360
    while a<-180: a+=360
    return a

def clip(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global last_t,mode,plan,seg_d,dir_w,seq_i,seq_t,last_print,last_touch,flip_t,still_t
    t=obs['t']
    m=obs['motion']; v=m['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    if last_t is not None:
        h=t-last_t
        x,y,yw=pose
        yw2=yw+v*math.tan(math.radians(st))/2.5*h
        x+=v*math.cos((yw+yw2)/2)*h; y+=v*math.sin((yw+yw2)/2)*h
        pose[0]=x; pose[1]=y; pose[2]=yw2
        if mode=='fwd': seg_d+=abs(v)*h
    last_t=t
    x,y,yw=pose; c=math.cos(yw); s=math.sin(yw)
    rig=obs['rig']
    vf=rig.get('vehicle_front',3.2)
    if isinstance(vf,(list,tuple)): vf=vf[0]
    try: vf=float(vf)
    except Exception: vf=3.2
    hw=rig.get('vehicle_half_width',1.15) or 1.15
    vr=vf-3.9
    views=obs.get('views') or {}
    for name,vw in views.items():
        if not vw: continue
        ox,oy=vw['origin']
        per=1 if name=='periphery' else 0
        for w in vw.get('walls',[]):
            b,d=w[0],w[1]
            px=ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)); py=oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))
            pts.append((x+c*px-s*py,y+s*px+c*py,t,per))
    keep=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<6.0]
    pts[:]=keep[-3000:]
    rx,ry=rig['trailer_rear']
    th=rig['trailer_heading_deg']
    thw=rig.get('trailer_half_width',1.2) or 1.2
    psi_b=th+180.0
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']
    fx=math.cos(math.radians(th)); fy=math.sin(math.radians(th))
    lx=-fy; ly=fx
    trR=9.0; trL=9.0; tcR=9.0; tcL=9.0
    loc=[]
    for wx,wy,tt,per in pts:
        dx=wx-x; dy=wy-y
        px=c*dx+s*dy; py=-s*dx+c*dy
        if not per: loc.append((px,py))
        if t-tt>2.0: continue
        ddx=px-rx; ddy=py-ry
        u=ddx*fx+ddy*fy; w=ddx*lx+ddy*ly
        cl=math.hypot(max(0.0,-u,u-4.6),max(0.0,abs(w)-thw))
        if w<0: trR=min(trR,cl)
        else: trL=min(trL,cl)
        cv=math.hypot(max(0.0,vr-px,px-vf),max(0.0,abs(py)-hw))
        if py<0: tcR=min(tcR,cv)
        else: tcL=min(tcL,cv)
    tmin=min(trR,trL); vmin=min(tcR,tcL)
    prog=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('covered') or 0.0
    rem=(obs.get('progress') or {}).get('remaining')
    tdir=None
    tg=obs.get('target') or {}
    if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
        ex,ey=rig['eye']
        tb=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); td=tg['dist_m']
        tx=ex+td*math.cos(tb); ty=ey+td*math.sin(tb)
        tdir=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-ry,tx-rx))
    best=psi_b; bestsc=-1e9; bestfree=8.0
    prev_v=None
    if dir_w is not None: prev_v=math.degrees(dir_w-yw)
    for a in range(-60,61,5):
        ang=psi_b+a
        ux=math.cos(math.radians(ang)); uy=math.sin(math.radians(ang))
        free=8.0
        for px,py in loc:
            dx=px-rx; dy=py-ry
            al=dx*ux+dy*uy
            if al<=-0.5 or al>=free: continue
            if abs(dx*uy-dy*ux)<1.5: free=max(al,0.0)
        sc=free-0.02*abs(a)
        if prog<16 and tdir is None: sc-=0.03*a
        if tdir is not None: sc-=0.05*abs(wrap(ang-tdir))
        if prev_v is not None: sc-=0.01*abs(wrap(ang-prev_v))
        if sc>bestsc: bestsc=sc; best=ang; bestfree=free
    bw=math.radians(best)+yw
    if dir_w is None: dir_w=bw
    else:
        d=math.atan2(math.sin(bw-dir_w),math.cos(bw-dir_w))
        dir_w+=0.3*d
    e=wrap(math.degrees(dir_w-yw)-psi_b)
    status=obs.get('status')
    hold=m.get('hold_s') or 0
    touches=obs['counters']['touches']
    if last_touch is None: last_touch=touches
    def away():
        if tcR<0.5 and tcR<tcL: return 20.0
        if tcL<0.5 and tcL<tcR: return -20.0
        return None
    def go_fwd(p):
        global mode,plan,seg_d,flip_t,still_t
        mode='fwd'; plan=p; seg_d=0.0; flip_t=t; still_t=None
    if touches>last_touch:
        last_touch=touches
        if mode=='rev': go_fwd([[1.2,away()]])
        else: mode='rev'; flip_t=t
    if abs(v)<0.03 and hold<=0:
        if still_t is None: still_t=t
        elif t-still_t>4 and t-flip_t>5:
            if mode=='rev': go_fwd([[1.2,away()]])
            else: mode='rev'; flip_t=t; still_t=None
    else: still_t=None
    if mode=='rev':
        if status=='JACKKNIFED' or abs(phi)>50: go_fwd([[2.0,None]])
        elif v<-0.05 and (tmin<0.12 or vmin<0.12): go_fwd([[1.2,away()]])
    if mode=='fwd':
        if v>0.05 and vmin<0.12 and t-flip_t>1.5: plan=[]
        while plan and seg_d>plan[0][0]:
            plan.pop(0); seg_d=0.0
        if not plan: mode='rev'; flip_t=t
    if mode=='rev':
        phi_des=clip(-0.8*e,-40,40)
        if trR<0.7: phi_des=max(phi_des,phi+(0.7-trR)*30)
        if trL<0.7: phi_des=min(phi_des,phi-(0.7-trL)*30)
        phi_des=clip(phi_des,-44,44)
        pr=math.radians(phi)
        ff=math.degrees(math.atan(2.5*math.sin(pr)/(3.6+1.3*math.cos(pr))))
        steer=clip(ff+2.5*(phi-phi_des),-45,45)
        if tcR<0.4 and tcR<tcL and phi<46: steer=min(steer,-5)
        if tcL<0.4 and tcL<tcR and phi>-46: steer=max(steer,5)
        spd=-0.3
        if tmin<0.4 or vmin<0.35: spd=-0.2
        if rem is not None and rem<4: spd=-0.22
        seq=[-64,150,-64,64,-150,-64]
    else:
        sd=plan[0][1] if plan else None
        steer=sd if sd is not None else clip(-0.5*phi,-20,20)
        if trR<0.25: steer=min(steer,0)
        if trL<0.25: steer=max(steer,0)
        if tcR<0.35: steer=max(steer,10)
        if tcL<0.35: steer=min(steer,-10)
        spd=0.5
        seq=[-40,-64,30,64]
    if t-seq_t>0.8:
        seq_i=(seq_i+1)%len(seq); seq_t=t
    look=seq[seq_i%len(seq)]
    if t-last_print>4:
        last_print=t
        print('t%.1f %s phi%.1f e%.1f st%.1f trR%.2f trL%.2f tcR%.2f tcL%.2f prog%.1f %s'%(t,mode,phi,e,steer,trR,trL,tcR,tcL,prog,status))
    return (steer,spd,look)

import math
L1=1.25
X=0.0;Y=0.0;PSI=0.0
pts={}
bdes=None
mode='rev'
fx=0.0;fy=0.0
last_touch=0
lastp=-10
Tmem=None
woke_near=0
CAP=5.0

def wrap(a):
    return (a+180.0)%360.0-180.0

def cl(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,PSI,bdes,mode,fx,fy,last_touch,lastp,Tmem,woke_near
    dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    m=obs['motion']; v=m['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    X+=v*math.cos(PSI)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(PSI)*dt
    PSI+=v/L1*math.tan(math.radians(st))*dt
    c=math.cos(PSI); s=math.sin(PSI)
    def tw(px,py):
        return (X+c*px-s*py, Y+s*px+c*py)
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']
    t=obs['t']
    touches=obs['counters']['touches']
    if touches>last_touch:
        last_touch=touches
        wake('touch #%d phi=%.1f steer=%.1f'%(touches,phi,st))
    status=obs.get('status')
    rig=obs['rig']
    try:
        views=obs.get('views') or {}
        dv=views.get('direct')
        if dv:
            o=dv['origin']
            for b,d in dv.get('walls',[]):
                if d<6.0:
                    br=math.radians(b)
                    w=tw(o[0]+d*math.cos(br),o[1]+d*math.sin(br))
                    pts[(round(w[0]/0.15),round(w[1]/0.15))]=w
    except Exception as ex:
        print('map err',ex)
    tr=rig['trailer_rear']; P=tw(tr[0],tr[1])
    beta=math.degrees(PSI)+180.0-phi
    if bdes is None: bdes=beta
    # forward recovery
    if mode=='rev' and (abs(phi)>45 or status in ('JACKKNIFED','PINNED')):
        mode='fwd'; fx=X; fy=Y
        print('FWD recovery t=%.1f phi=%.1f status=%s'%(t,phi,status))
    if mode=='fwd':
        moved=math.hypot(X-fx,Y-fy)
        if (moved>0.8 and abs(phi)<8) or moved>2.0:
            mode='rev'; bdes=beta
        else:
            return (0.0,0.6,-170)
    goal=bdes
    tin=False
    try:
        tg=obs.get('target') or {}
        if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
            e=rig['eye']; br=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); d=tg['dist_m']
            Tmem=tw(e[0]+d*math.cos(br),e[1]+d*math.sin(br)); tin=True
        P0,P1=P
        near=[q for q in pts.values() if abs(q[0]-P0)<CAP+1 and abs(q[1]-P1)<CAP+1]
        angs=list(range(-70,71,5)); frees=[]
        for a in angs:
            ar=math.radians(beta+a); ux=math.cos(ar); uy=math.sin(ar)
            free=CAP
            for q in near:
                rx=q[0]-P0; ry=q[1]-P1
                al=rx*ux+ry*uy
                if al<0.1 or al>=free: continue
                if abs(rx*uy-ry*ux)<0.75: free=al
            frees.append(free)
        mx=max(frees)
        bi=max(range(len(angs)),key=lambda i: frees[i]-0.001*abs(angs[i]))
        thr=0.85*mx
        lo=bi; hi=bi
        while lo>0 and frees[lo-1]>=thr: lo-=1
        while hi<len(angs)-1 and frees[hi+1]>=thr: hi+=1
        mid=(angs[lo]+angs[hi])/2.0
        goal=beta+mid
        if Tmem is not None and tin:
            dT=math.hypot(Tmem[0]-P0,Tmem[1]-P1)
            if dT>1.2:
                goal=math.degrees(math.atan2(Tmem[1]-P1,Tmem[0]-P0))
            else:
                goal=bdes
        if t-lastp>2.0:
            lastp=t
            print('t=%.1f P=(%.2f,%.2f) beta=%.0f bdes=%.0f phi=%.1f st=%.1f mx=%.1f mid=%.0f n=%d tin=%s'%(t,P0,P1,beta,bdes,phi,st,mx,mid,len(pts),tin))
    except Exception as ex:
        print('guid err',ex)
    bdes=bdes+0.3*wrap(goal-bdes)
    e=wrap(bdes-beta)
    phid=cl(-0.8*e,-25,25)
    ff=math.degrees(math.atan(1.09*math.sin(math.radians(phi))))
    steer=cl(ff+2.0*(phi-phid),-45,45)
    speed=-0.45
    if abs(phi)>30: speed=-0.3
    # nose safety
    try:
        vf=rig['vehicle_front']
        if isinstance(vf,(list,tuple)): vf=vf[0]
        hw=rig['vehicle_half_width']
        mind=9
        for cy in (hw,-hw):
            C=tw(vf,cy)
            for q in pts.values():
                dd=math.hypot(q[0]-C[0],q[1]-C[1])
                if dd<mind: mind=dd
        if mind<0.25:
            speed=-0.25
            if t-woke_near>5:
                woke_near=t; print('nose near rail %.2f'%mind)
    except Exception as ex:
        pass
    return (steer,speed,-170)

import math
L1=1.25
X=0.0;Y=0.0;PSI=0.0
mp={}
Tw=[-4.14,-6.78]
mode='R'
fx=0.0;fy=0.0
nf=0
last_touch=None
lastp=-10
frz=None

def wrap(a):
    return (a+180.0)%360.0-180.0

def cl(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,PSI,Tw,mode,fx,fy,nf,last_touch,lastp,frz
    dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    X+=v*math.cos(PSI)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(PSI)*dt
    PSI+=v/L1*math.tan(math.radians(st))*dt
    c=math.cos(PSI); s=math.sin(PSI)
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']; t=obs['t']; status=obs.get('status')
    rig=obs['rig']
    tc=obs['counters']['touches']
    if last_touch is None: last_touch=tc
    touched=tc>last_touch
    if touched:
        last_touch=tc; wake('touch #%d mode=%s phi=%.1f st=%.1f'%(tc,mode,phi,st))
    live=[]
    try:
        for k,vw in (obs.get('views') or {}).items():
            if not vw: continue
            o=vw['origin']
            for b,d in vw.get('walls',[]):
                br=math.radians(b); px=o[0]+d*math.cos(br); py=o[1]+d*math.sin(br)
                if k=='direct':
                    if d<5.0:
                        wx=X+c*px-s*py; wy=Y+s*px+c*py
                        mp[(round(wx/0.1),round(wy/0.1))]=(wx,wy)
                elif d<1.5:
                    live.append((px,py))
    except Exception as ex:
        print('view err',ex)
    B=list(live)
    for (wx,wy) in mp.values():
        dx=wx-X; dy=wy-Y
        if abs(dx)<4 and abs(dy)<4:
            B.append((c*dx+s*dy,-s*dx+c*dy))
    try:
        tg=obs.get('target') or {}
        if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
            e0=rig['eye']; br=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); d=tg['dist_m']
            px=e0[0]+d*math.cos(br); py=e0[1]+d*math.sin(br)
            W=(X+c*px-s*py, Y+s*px+c*py)
            g=0.05 if d>4 else 0.15
            Tw[0]+=g*(W[0]-Tw[0]); Tw[1]+=g*(W[1]-Tw[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    psd=math.degrees(PSI)
    P=rig['trailer_rear']; H=rig['hitch']
    cur=math.degrees(math.atan2(P[1]-H[1],P[0]-H[0]))
    dx=Tw[0]-X; dy=Tw[1]-Y
    tx=c*dx+s*dy; ty=-s*dx+c*dy
    dT=math.hypot(tx-P[0],ty-P[1])
    des=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-P[1],tx-P[0]))
    if dT<1.6 or frz is not None:
        if frz is None: frz=psd+des
        des=frz-psd
    hwT=rig.get('trailer_half_width',0.475)
    ux=math.cos(math.radians(cur)); uy=math.sin(math.radians(cur))
    Pl=(P[0]-uy*hwT,P[1]+ux*hwT); Pr=(P[0]+uy*hwT,P[1]-ux*hwT)
    cL=9.0; cR=9.0
    for q in B:
        cL=min(cL,math.hypot(q[0]-Pl[0],q[1]-Pl[1])); cR=min(cR,math.hypot(q[0]-Pr[0],q[1]-Pr[1]))
    if cL<0.3: des-=(0.3-cL)*80.0
    if cR<0.3: des+=(0.3-cR)*80.0
    e=wrap(des-cur)
    phid=cl(-0.8*e,-35,35)
    ff=math.degrees(math.atan(1.09*math.sin(math.radians(phi))))
    pref=cl(ff+2.0*(phi-phid),-45,45)
    vf=rig.get('vehicle_front',1.55)
    if isinstance(vf,(list,tuple)): vf=vf[0]
    hw=rig.get('vehicle_half_width',0.525)
    cor=[(vf,hw),(vf,-hw),(vf-1.8,hw),(vf-1.8,-hw)]
    close=[]; mind=9.0
    for C in cor:
        for q in B:
            ddx=q[0]-C[0]; ddy=q[1]-C[1]; d=math.hypot(ddx,ddy)
            if d<mind: mind=d
            if d<0.4 and d>1e-6: close.append((C,ddx/d,ddy/d,d))
    def ok(vv,sd):
        w=vv*math.tan(math.radians(sd))/L1
        for C,nx,ny,d in close:
            ap=(vv-w*C[1])*nx+(w*C[0])*ny
            if ap>max(0.0,d-0.12)*0.5: return False
        return True
    def pick(vv,p):
        cands=[p]+sorted(range(-45,46,5),key=lambda a: abs(a-p))
        for sd in cands:
            if ok(vv,sd): return sd
        return None
    gz=70
    if (t%7.0)>5.4: gz=-80
    if t-lastp>2.0:
        lastp=t
        print('%s t=%.1f psi=%.0f phi=%.1f st=%.1f pref=%.1f cur=%.0f des=%.0f dT=%.1f mind=%.2f cL=%.2f cR=%.2f nclose=%d'%(mode,t,psd,phi,st,pref,cur,des,dT,mind,cL,cR,len(close)))
    if mode=='R':
        sd=pick(-0.35,pref)
        if touched or abs(phi)>40 or status=='JACKKNIFED' or sd is None:
            mode='F'; fx=X; fy=Y; nf+=1
            print('F t=%.1f phi=%.1f sd=%s mind=%.2f'%(t,phi,sd,mind))
            if nf>4: wake('fwd recovery #%d'%nf)
        else:
            sp=-0.25 if mind<0.3 else -0.35
            return (sd,sp,gz)
    mv=math.hypot(X-fx,Y-fy)
    sdr=pick(-0.35,pref)
    if ((mv>0.7 and abs(phi)<15) or mv>1.5) and sdr is not None:
        mode='R'
        return (sdr,-0.3,gz)
    sf=pick(0.4,0.0)
    if sf is None: sf=0.0
    return (sf,0.4,gz)

import math
L1=1.25
X=0.0;Y=0.0;PSI=0.0
mp={}
Tw=[-5.25,-6.61]
mode='R'
fx=0.0;fy=0.0
nf=0
last_touch=None
lastp=-10
frz=None

def wrap(a):
    return (a+180.0)%360.0-180.0

def cl(v,a,b):
    return max(a,min(b,v))

def control(obs):
    global X,Y,PSI,mode,fx,fy,nf,last_touch,lastp,frz
    dt=obs.get('dt',0.1) or 0.1
    v=obs['motion']['v_mps']; st=obs['steer_deg']
    X+=v*math.cos(PSI)*dt; Y+=v*math.sin(PSI)*dt
    PSI+=v/L1*math.tan(math.radians(st))*dt
    c=math.cos(PSI); s=math.sin(PSI)
    phi=obs['hitch_deg']; t=obs['t']; status=obs.get('status')
    rig=obs['rig']
    tc=obs['counters']['touches']
    if last_touch is None: last_touch=tc
    touched=tc>last_touch
    if touched:
        last_touch=tc; wake('touch #%d mode=%s phi=%.1f st=%.1f'%(tc,mode,phi,st))
    try:
        for k,vw in (obs.get('views') or {}).items():
            if not vw: continue
            o=vw['origin']
            for b,d in vw.get('walls',[]):
                if d<5.0:
                    br=math.radians(b); px=o[0]+d*math.cos(br); py=o[1]+d*math.sin(br)
                    wx=X+c*px-s*py; wy=Y+s*px+c*py
                    mp[(round(wx/0.1),round(wy/0.1))]=(wx,wy)
    except Exception as ex:
        print('view err',ex)
    B=[]
    for (wx,wy) in mp.values():
        dx=wx-X; dy=wy-Y
        if abs(dx)<4 and abs(dy)<4:
            B.append((c*dx+s*dy,-s*dx+c*dy))
    try:
        tg=obs.get('target') or {}
        if tg.get('in_sight') and tg.get('bearing_deg') is not None:
            e0=rig['eye']; br=math.radians(tg['bearing_deg']); d=tg['dist_m']
            px=e0[0]+d*math.cos(br); py=e0[1]+d*math.sin(br)
            W=(X+c*px-s*py, Y+s*px+c*py)
            g=0.04 if d>4 else 0.15
            Tw[0]+=g*(W[0]-Tw[0]); Tw[1]+=g*(W[1]-Tw[1])
    except Exception:
        pass
    psd=math.degrees(PSI)
    P=rig['trailer_rear']; H=rig['hitch']
    cur=math.degrees(math.atan2(P[1]-H[1],P[0]-H[0]))
    dx=Tw[0]-X; dy=Tw[1]-Y
    tx=c*dx+s*dy; ty=-s*dx+c*dy
    dT=math.hypot(tx-P[0],ty-P[1])
    des=math.degrees(math.atan2(ty-P[1],tx-P[0]))
    if dT<1.6 or frz is not None:
        if frz is None: frz=psd+des
        des=frz-psd
    hwT=rig.get('trailer_half_width',0.475)
    ux=math.cos(math.radians(cur)); uy=math.sin(math.radians(cur))
    Pl=(P[0]-uy*hwT,P[1]+ux*hwT); Pr=(P[0]+uy*hwT,P[1]-ux*hwT)
    cL=9.0; cR=9.0
    for q in B:
        cL=min(cL,math.hypot(q[0]-Pl[0],q[1]-Pl[1])); cR=min(cR,math.hypot(q[0]-Pr[0],q[1]-Pr[1]))
    if cL<0.3: des-=(0.3-cL)*60.0
    if cR<0.3: des+=(0.3-cR)*60.0
    vf=rig.get('vehicle_front',1.55)
    if isinstance(vf,(list,tuple)): vf=vf[0]
    hw=rig.get('vehicle_half_width',0.525)
    def clr(px,py):
        m=9.0
        for q in B:
            dd=math.hypot(q[0]-px,q[1]-py)
            if dd<m: m=dd
        return m
    cfl=clr(vf,hw); cfr=clr(vf,-hw); crl=clr(vf-1.8,hw); crr=clr(vf-1.8,-hw)
    gz=60
    if (t%8.0)>6.5: gz=-70
    if t-lastp>2.0:
        lastp=t
        print('%s t=%.1f psi=%.0f phi=%.1f st=%.1f cur=%.0f des=%.0f dT=%.1f cfl=%.2f cfr=%.2f crl=%.2f crr=%.2f cL=%.2f cR=%.2f'%(mode,t,psd,phi,st,cur,des,dT,cfl,cfr,crl,crr,cL,cR))
    if mode=='R':
        if touched or status in ('PINNED','JACKKNIFED') or phi<-48 or phi>40 or cfl<0.05:
            mode='F'; fx=X; fy=Y; nf+=1
            print('F t=%.1f phi=%.1f cfl=%.2f'%(t,phi,cfl))
            if nf>3: wake('fwd recovery #%d'%nf)
        else:
            e=wrap(des-cur)
            phid=cl(-0.7*e,-30,15)
            ff=math.degrees(math.atan(1.09*math.sin(math.radians(phi))))
            steer=ff+2.0*(phi-phid)
            sp=-0.3
            if cfl<0.35:
                steer+=(0.35-cfl)*150.0; sp=-0.2
            if crl<0.12 and steer>0:
                steer*=0.5
            if cfr<0.15 or crr<0.12 or crl<0.15: sp=-0.2
            return (cl(steer,-45,45),sp,gz)
    mv=math.hypot(X-fx,Y-fy)
    if (mv>0.5 and phi>-28 and phi<20 and cfl>0.2) or mv>1.2 or (mv>0.2 and (cfr<0.1 or min(cfl,cfr)<0.06)):
        mode='R'
        return (0.0,-0.2,gz)
    sf=-20.0 if cfl<cfr else 0.0
    if cfr<0.15: sf=10.0
    return (sf,0.4,gz)
